event: a flood from the verified record (build_verified_floods.py: confirmed by the validated radar test, Google's Global Flood Database or a gauge crossing), centred in the ~10 km rain cell, on its date
calibration_days: 2024-01-01..2025-10-31 (the flood record ends there; before 2026-09-27 this ran to 2026-07-29 and counted Feb-Jul 2026 as flood-free)

soil_wetness.design: flat rain cells (mean slope < 5 deg, 380 cells) use a second day model that also sees top-metre soil water on day t-16, as the cell's own May-Oct percentile; every other cell, and any day without soil data, uses the rain-only model
